data.why: The app bundles its own public aggregated datasets at src/assets/geo-cases.json and src/assets/doses.json, fetched automatically via HttpClient on load; there is no upload UI, so nothing needs to be handed to the browser as a test file.

goals: See the regional distribution of confirmed yellow fever cases across Brazil's five regions
Break down cases by age group and sex to spot which demographics are most affected
Filter cases by year, region, state, age band, and sex to narrow the analysis
Compare vaccine doses applied against case counts over time to gauge vaccination efficiency
Examine the long-term (1995-2023) time series of case counts to identify outbreak years

review.summary: The goal and phases match what the README says the dashboard is for: where, when and in whom yellow fever cases occur, set against vaccine doses applied. Every cited screen I checked shows what the node claims, and the broken filters are honestly recorded. Before filing, it needs small cleanups: drop a UI-click task, add the missing seasonal-chart feature, and add caveats to the filter feature.
